# Plan 5: commit-hygiene, format before staging

Spec: `specs/commit-hygiene-format.md` (approved)
Micro-test record: `specs/red-baseline-commit-hygiene.md`
File changed: `skills/commit-hygiene/SKILL.md` (nothing else)

## Goal

Add one paragraph under `## Before you commit` and one row at the end of the `## Red Flags` table. Both texts come from the spec and are used word for word, because they were micro-tested in exactly that form.

## Steps

### 1. Add the paragraph under `## Before you commit`

The section has one paragraph today:

```
Read the staged diff with `git diff --cached` before every commit. The commit holds what the index holds.
```

Insert the new paragraph directly after it, with one blank line before it and one blank line between it and `## Red Flags`:

```
Run the formatter before you stage, never after. A formatter run after `git add` changes the working tree but not the index, and the commit ships the index.
```

The spec shows this text as a `>` blockquote only to set it apart. It goes into the skill as a plain paragraph, with no `>`, matching the existing paragraph. Do not change the wording, punctuation, or backticks.

### 2. Add the last row to the `## Red Flags` table

Append this row after the existing row `| "The diff is small, I don't need to read it" | Small diffs hide stray edits. Read it. |`:

```
| "I'll format after staging, it's the same files" | The index keeps the unformatted copy. Run the formatter, then `git add`. |
```

Neither cell contains a `|`, so the row has exactly two cells. Leave no blank line between this row and the rows above it, or the table ends early.

### 3. Check the result

The full file after steps 1 and 2 must read:

```
---
name: commit-hygiene
description: Use when staging or committing changes in this repository.
---

# Commit hygiene

## Before you commit

Read the staged diff with `git diff --cached` before every commit. The commit holds what the index holds.

Run the formatter before you stage, never after. A formatter run after `git add` changes the working tree but not the index, and the commit ships the index.

## Red Flags

| Thought | Reality |
|---|---|
| "The diff is small, I don't need to read it" | Small diffs hide stray edits. Read it. |
| "I'll format after staging, it's the same files" | The index keeps the unformatted copy. Run the formatter, then `git add`. |
```

Compare the two added lines character by character against the spec. Frontmatter, heading, and existing lines must be unchanged.

### 4. Run the test

```
uv run python build/check_skill_tables.py
```

Expected: it passes. It checks that every Red Flags row has two cells. If it fails, report the output. Do not reword the row to make it pass; the wording is fixed by the spec, so take a failure back to the partner.

## Out of scope

- Any other wording change, reordering, or new section in `SKILL.md`.
- Changes to other skills or to `build/check_skill_tables.py`.
- Re-running the micro-test. The spec's texts are already tested.
